nl: Add the line `203.0.113.20 cache.internal.example.com cache` to etc/hosts.

etc/hosts.text:
127.0.0.1 localhost
::1 localhost ip6-localhost
203.0.113.5 db.internal.example.com db
203.0.113.20 cache.internal.example.com cache

oracle_program:
edit "etc/hosts" changes: [{replace: "db.internal.example.com db
", with: "db.internal.example.com db
203.0.113.20 cache.internal.example.com cache
"}]
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/hosts'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('db.internal.example.com db\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('db.internal.example.com db\n', 'db.internal.example.com db\n203.0.113.20 cache.internal.example.com cache\n'))
EOF
